cavity.scope: Finite all-part empty nursery routes/samples and real inner-floor first-hit rays. Fixed sprouts occupy other regions; no universal cavity, planting or drainage claim.

rim.scope: Actual used distinct inner/outer opening indices and finite annular dimensions, not an optical refraction or water-flow guarantee.

planarCaps.scope: Actual declared geometrically flat glass/pine cap triangles and every used normal; rounded sides remain separately shaded.

diagnosticFloor.scope: Twenty actual foot-bottom/diagnostic-plane triangle pairs and finite lower half-space only. Current Scene pairing, installation, load and stability are separate.

roundedStemTips.scope: Three actual indexed spherical-ending profiles and real top pole fans; no flat top cap. Finite authored shape, not botanical growth or continuous visual quality.

audit.scope: One fixed glass/pine/sprout assembly; selected finite geometry and diagnostic support criteria only. No actual planting, growth, hydrology, light, loading, installation, wearer fit or ordinary gameplay/ownership/save verified.

vertex_counter_semantics: Actual transformed per-Mesh vertex instances and unique geometry stored vertices are separate counts; shared instances are not new geometry storage.

geometryIdentity.method: SHA256 explicit typed position/index layout and underlying bytes. Object storage, exact content and rendered part instances are distinct counts.

cameras.scope: 135 finite actual transformed per-Mesh vertex-instance projections plus8 separate real box corners. Shared geometry is not new storage/test credit. No continuous or occlusion/pixel guarantee.

probe.contactSupportKind: five actual bottom-triangle samples on each of four authored closed flat-bottom wooden feet

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

probe.buildingProxyScope: actual current place-group mesh AABBs only; not full building geometry or transparent original-art fixture volume clearance

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against entire sprout-planter XZ AABB

probe.limits: one fixed authored standalone sprout-planter pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;20 finite foot-bottom/floor triangle pairs on four actual authored wooden feet,63 finite walkability samples and conservative current road, original-card, meadow, shore and building-proxy envelope clearances. These finite witnesses do not verify full foot surface contact, planting/growth/watering/drainage/light physics, installation/navigation, support stability, load, physical behavior, body fit, whole-world placement or all-camera visibility

placement.Node_DOM_limitation: Actual existing winter Scene geometry at one candidate anchor only. Node does not decode browser image assets; actual browser originalArtready/post-art world baseline remains a separate native gate.
